title: Event-Sourced Framework Version Control End to End
description: Get the framework version control running end to end with event sourcing: no retrospective snapshot merging; artifacts are materialized by projecting all mutations; persistence stores only an initial snapshot plus the history of semantic changes. Symptom: two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone fails (ignored in lowpoly/remodel) because the store's merge_remote_snapshot always refuses and structural commands broadcast full snapshots.
